title: Control Zoho CRM with Claude AI via MCP #Shorts
description:
Connect Claude Desktop directly to Zoho CRM using an executable FastMCP Python server script and Zoho CRM REST API v3. Execute conversational deal queries and automate record updates without manual dashboard work.

1. Add the Zoho CRM MCP server config into your claude_desktop_config.json file
2. Authenticate with Zoho OAuth 2.0 scopes for CRM record access
3. Ask Claude in plain English: 'Find all unassigned deals over $50k and draft follow-up tasks'

API / tool used:
- name: Zoho CRM REST API v3 via FastMCP
- endpoint: https://www.zohoapis.com/crm/v3
- scope: ZohoCRM.modules.ALL, ZohoCRM.settings.ALL
- docs: https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v3/

Code (python) - Save locally as zoho_crm_mcp.py and register in Claude Desktop via claude_desktop_config.json:
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
import os
import requests

mcp = FastMCP("zoho-crm")

CLIENT_ID = os.environ.get("ZOHO_CLIENT_ID", "")
CLIENT_SECRET = os.environ.get("ZOHO_CLIENT_SECRET", "")
REFRESH_TOKEN = os.environ.get("ZOHO_REFRESH_TOKEN", "")

def get_access_token() -› str:
    url = "https://accounts.zoho.com/oauth/v2/token"
    params = {
        "refresh_token": REFRESH_TOKEN,
        "client_id": CLIENT_ID,
        "client_secret": CLIENT_SECRET,
        "grant_type": "refresh_token"
    }
    response = requests.post(url, params=params)
    return response.json().get("access_token", "")

@mcp.tool()
def get_deals() -› list:
    """Query Deals module from Zoho CRM."""
    token = get_access_token()
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Zoho-oauthtoken {token}"}
    res = requests.get("https://www.zohoapis.com/crm/v3/Deals", headers=headers)
    return res.json().get("data", [])

@mcp.tool()
def create_task(subject: str, deal_id: str) -› dict:
    """Create follow-up task for a deal in Zoho CRM."""
    token = get_access_token()
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Zoho-oauthtoken {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
    payload = {"data": [{"Subject": subject, "$se_module": "Deals", "What_Id": deal_id}]}
    res = requests.post("https://www.zohoapis.com/crm/v3/Tasks", headers=headers, json=payload)
    return res.json()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    mcp.run(transport="stdio")
